name: hot-memory
description: Measure per-kernel hot working sets, memory traffic, and FLOPs in MPI C/C++/Fortran codes for GPU memory planning.

interface.shortDescription: Profile MPI kernel hot working sets and GPU memory needs.
interface.longDescription: Measure per-kernel hot memory, memory traffic, and FLOPs in MPI applications to plan GPU memory requirements. Fetches the WSS profiler library from GitHub, builds it locally, and instruments C/C++/Fortran code.
defaultPrompt: Measure the hot working set of my MPI kernels.
